summary: Iteration 20 — BUG VERIFY: 'blank white after Cloudflare deploy' on the USER-DEPLOYED production site https://dianastuff.com. NOT REPRODUCIBLE — all public pages render correctly on the currently deployed bundle. Verified via Playwright (mobile viewport 390x844) against https://dianastuff.com: (1) / landing renders hero 'Belanja Seru di dianastuff' with landing-belanja, landing-live, landing-login-top testIDs all visible (NOT blank, body has full content). (2) Click 'Belanja Sekarang' → navigates to /login and login page renders with 'Login Gmail'/'Login Whitelist' tabs + 'Login dengan Google' button. (3) /live direct deep-link renders 'Belum ada siaran live' empty-state screen (Agora SDK joins channel successfully as audience); hard RELOAD of /live also renders correctly (SPA _redirects fallback works). (4) /toko storefront renders 'Etalase Toko' with live products (Blouse Katun Premium Rp 89.000, Dress Floral Rp 159.000, Kemeja Oversize Rp 119.000) — cross-origin API calls from dianastuff.com to the preview backend WORK (products loaded). (5) /login deep-link renders both tabs; tab switch to 'Login Whitelist' shows Username/Password/Masuk/'Minta Akun via WhatsApp'; reload of /login works. (6) HTTP-level: /, /live, /login, /toko, /landing all return 200 text/html. Console: NO fatal JS errors (zero pageerror events) on any page. Only benign noise: Agora SDK debug/info logs, one expected warning 'WebSocket connection to wss://...edge.sd-rtn.com:4705 failed: closed before established' (Agora's backup-race websocket — primary edge.agora.io connects fine), and one ERR_ABORTED on Cloudflare's own /cdn-cgi/rum beacon (harmless). CONCLUSION: the reported blank-white issue is not reproducible on the current deployment — most likely stale browser cache/service-worker or a transient bundle-load failure on the user's device at first visit. Recommend user hard-refresh / clear site data once; if it recurs, capture device console. NOTE: current bundle still points API at the PREVIEW backend (https://diana-store-2.preview.emergentagent.com) — works now due to open CORS, but the new web.zip pointing to production backend (https://diana-store-2.emergent.host) should still be uploaded by the user for production correctness.
action_items: User-side guidance: the deployed site renders correctly; ask the user to hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R / clear site data) — the blank was almost certainly stale cache or first-load timing on their device.
User should re-upload the NEW web.zip (pointing to production backend https://diana-store-2.emergent.host) so the deployed bundle no longer depends on the preview backend URL.
Optional: consider adding a version/build stamp to the exported bundle so future 'is the deploy updated?' questions can be verified from the client.
critical_code_review_comments: No code changes needed for the reported bug — deployment is healthy. Root layout gate (_layout.tsx:36-49) correctly treats '/', '/landing', '/toko', '/live', '/login' as public routes, so guests are not bounced away and no blank screen occurs.
Landing page testIDs (landing-belanja, landing-live, landing-login-top, landing-live-cta, landing-toko-cta) are present in the deployed bundle and functional.

rca_of_issue: REPORTED BUG: 'Setelah deploy cloudflare malah blank putih' (blank white after Cloudflare deploy). REPRODUCTION: attempted on /, /live, /login, /toko, /landing — none reproduce; all render fully with zero pageerror events. LIKELY CAUSE: stale cache/service worker on the user's device, or a transient JS bundle fetch failure on first visit (bundle is ~2.9MB — slow networks may show white until loaded; no loading splash in exported HTML). MITIGATION: hard refresh / clear site data; optionally add an inline loading indicator in the exported index.html and shorter cache TTL for the entry HTML so new deploys invalidate immediately.
